import gzip, json
with gzip.open('tasks/t0113_t0106_seed2247_replicate/assets/predictions/t0113-bedb-morph-nsga2-seed2247/files/all_evaluations_seed2247.json.gz', 'rt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = json.load(f)
cells = data['evaluations']
# Joint pass
jp = [c for c in cells if c['dsi_vector_sum'] >= 0.5 and c['pd_rate_hz'] >= 30]
print('n_joint_pass_evals:', len(jp))
print('Unique-by-vector_68d joint_pass:', len({tuple(c['vector_68d']) for c in jp}))
print('All joint-pass DSI values:', [c['dsi_vector_sum'] for c in jp])
print('All joint-pass PD values:', [c['pd_rate_hz'] for c in jp])
# DSI==1
ones = [c for c in cells if c['dsi_vector_sum'] >= 1.0]
print('n cells with DSI>=1.0:', len(ones))
print('Their PD-rates:', sorted({c['pd_rate_hz'] for c in ones})[:10])
# Top legit
legit = sorted([(c['dsi_vector_sum'], c['pd_rate_hz'], c['generation']) for c in cells if c['dsi_vector_sum'] < 1.0], key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)[:5]
print('Top 5 legit DSI:', legit)
# Best PD
top_pd = sorted([(c['dsi_vector_sum'], c['pd_rate_hz'], c['generation']) for c in cells], key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5]
print('Top 5 PD:', top_pd)
